decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on established pharmacy channels and costs little to carry, so with no negative evidence the option is still worth holding.
The skin and hair supplement fits the consumer health strategy and is cheap to maintain, and the lack of website evidence since 2019 does not yet show that its value is unlikely to be realized.
As an extension of the established Trivital brand, the joint health supplement has low carrying costs and solid demand in an ageing market, so keeping it is sensible.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche product, but demand for immune products rose during the pandemic and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open for another year.
The OTC triptan is distant from the core offer, but it rests on an approved switch with a clear self-medication market, and its value is not yet resolved, so it is kept while results become clearer.
